1.repair: Capture the entire selected SQL scan window before telemetry; quality captures SQL first and reads sources/ledger afterwards. The source-selection caller already closes SQL before authorization/projection. All 3 transaction-boundary probes pass, including both HTTP routes with 6s telemetry. Additional quality I/O probe was red on the base.

red.observation: 6s telemetry: HTTP 400; telemetry transaction flags [True, True]; quality source/ledger flags [True, True].

2.repair: Normal not-started and in-progress reasons share one definition beside the receipt/formation writers. Only stored failure reasons or failed/interrupted/expired latest attempts count as processing blocks; compact summaries expose only attempt state/expiry, never processing details. Both new/running probes and the existing stored-block/revocation probe pass (3 cases).

3.repair: Unknown candidate counts cause a notice only for an account with processing access. Publishers receive stored-block/error notices without processing details; missing access alone produces no notice. The new publisher probe and updated revocation/unknown-count probe pass (2 cases).

red.observation: Publisher with no processing access received an unknown-count notice for a normal document.

4.repair: Raad captures at most 50 documents per SQL batch and stops at 8 notices or its cooperative 4s operation budget. Each batch closes before telemetry/filtering; SQL statement deadlines are lowered to the remaining budget. Failed/timed-out batches log an explicit diagnostic and return earlier rows with complete=false and the first unexamined offset. Four error/timeout/budget/scan-limit probes pass. Synthetic PG storage: 78,864,936 total object bytes; 50/50/1-document batches took 0.033869/0.036487/0.003597 seconds. Not representative Azure evidence.

red.observation: Old code selected all 51 documents in one batch and returned complete=True; second-batch failure never exercised.

5.repair: Any visible busy/waiting source document now enables the existing 5s reload and refresh text, including the overview without a document parameter. No overview buttons added. Recorded pending/claimed characterization goldens with --record-characterization; all 45 characterization/source cases pass. Diff audit: 32 existing goldens changed only the Raad asset hash; two new source-overview goldens capture the requested behavior. The asset also hides unavailable candidate-count text for publisher-only notices.

red.observation: Overview omitted window.location.reload() and the existing refresh text.

6.repair: Discovery looks ahead through at least 50 documents while pending still limits returned tasks. An expired document no longer hides the following pending task in the same round; expiry work remains bounded to 50 documents for limit=1. Both the supplied expired-then-pending probe and a 51-expired-document bound/progress probe pass.

red.observation: pending(limit=1) returned [] instead of the waiting task after an expired document.
